blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The Mandaue City government is considering thereimplementation of a four-day compressed workweek or a work-from-home setup on Fridays as part of its efforts to conserve electricity amid rotational brownouts caused by insufficient power supply. City Administrator Atty. Gonzalo Malig-on Jr. said the proposal has been discussed with Mayor Thadeo “Jonkie” Ouano, but no final decision has been made. Malig-on said the mayor’s main consideration is the impact of such an arrangement on residents who need to transact with the city government.
